semiconductor_relevance: High — SEC Co., Ltd. specializes in advanced inspection systems for the semiconductor industry, particularly in X-ray and scanning electron microscopy.
summary: SEC Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures industrial X-ray inspection systems and scanning electron microscopes (SEM) that are utilized in the semiconductor, automotive, and battery industries. With over 30 years of expertise, the company focuses on enhancing product quality and reliability through advanced inspection technologies.
capabilities: Non-destructive testing equipment for semiconductor packaging

regional_presence.Korea: Headquartered in Suwon, Korea, SEC Co., Ltd. has a strong presence in the domestic market and is recognized for its advanced inspection technologies.
